svg.title: The batching knee: throughput and per-token latency vs batch size
svg.desc: Dual-axis chart against batch size B from 0 to 512 on a linear scale. Left axis, throughput in tokens per second, rises linearly with slope 50 tokens/s per unit batch up to B_crit, then flattens at its plateau of 14,750 tokens/s. Right axis, per-token latency in milliseconds, stays flat at 20 ms up to B_crit then rises linearly. A vertical line at B_crit approximately 295 is labelled the knee, with the region to its left shaded and labelled free lunch and the region to its right shaded and labelled you now pay latency.

text.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The batching knee: free throughput, then a latency bill
